scope: Six semantic concepts required by the CML-07 Craft identity chain for one exact successor-definition authoring use.

records.context: The Product identity needed by CML-07 to preserve Craft as the same Product lineage renamed from DomainSpec v2 while keeping Project, Method, Goal, Feature, Capability, Bounded Context, and realization separate.
records.intended_use: Candidate semantic input for a Lab Product Definition and later Product Identity Artifact Type.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE for changed Product meaning, source, context, or consumer.

propose.normative_voice: A Product is a durable identity-bearing boundary for a coherent purpose and promise of value. Projects may coordinate it, Methods may be embodied by it, and Features, Capabilities, contexts, and realizations may relate to it, but none becomes the Product or acquires its authority through that relation.
propose.formal_voice: Product(p) = (identity, purpose, value_promise, lineage, owner_route); related(p,x) does not imply p = x or authority(p) = authority(x).
propose.plain_language_voice: A Product is the enduring thing that promises value. Projects organize work around it and methods help build it, but neither is the Product.
propose.domain_context_voice: Craft is the current name of the same Product lineage formerly called DomainSpec v2. Product placement does not create a Craft root Bounded Context.
propose.boundary: Product is not Project, Method, Goal, Product Feature, Product Capability, Bounded Context, repository, directory, or implementation.
propose.drift_route: Return through CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE, then definitions-governance owner review.

records.context: Generic Method meaning required to type Craft Method as a separate specialization in CML-07.
records.intended_use: Exact reuse binding for the successor Lab Method Definition record.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE if CAV2-D32 or the CML-07 context changes.

records.context: The governed recursive system-building Method embodied by the Craft Product and used by the Craft Project without identity collapse.
records.intended_use: Exact reuse binding for the successor Lab Craft Method Definition record and later Method Binding contract.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE if CAV2-D20 or the CML-07 binding context changes.

records.context: Goal meaning required to represent one Project-owned desired outcome without treating activity, validation, or agent claims as achievement.
records.intended_use: Exact reuse binding for the successor Lab Goal Definition record and later Goal carrier contract.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE if CAV2-D59 or the CML-07 Goal use changes.

records.context: Project meaning required to represent the durable Craft coordination boundary separately from Product, Method, Goal, repository, and authority.
records.intended_use: Exact reuse binding for the successor Lab Project Definition record and later Project Identity contract.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE if CAV2-D60 or the CML-07 Project use changes.

records.context: The explicit typed connection needed to represent dependent classifications without redundant canonical labels, endpoint collapse, directory inference, or authority transfer.
records.intended_use: Candidate semantic input for a Lab Identity Relation Definition and later Identity Graph contract.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE for changed relation meaning, endpoints, context, or consumer.

propose.normative_voice: An Identity Relation is a separately governed typed edge with a stable relation identity, kind, source endpoint, target endpoint, owner, evidence, and lifecycle. It preserves endpoint identities and authority; dependent classifications use explicit relations rather than silently inferred or redundant canonical labels.
propose.formal_voice: R = (relation_id, kind, from_ref, to_ref, owner_ref, evidence_refs, lifecycle); R(a,b) does not imply a = b or authority(a) = authority(b).
propose.plain_language_voice: An Identity Relation says exactly how two separate things are connected without turning them into the same thing or transferring authority.
propose.domain_context_voice: The Craft graph uses explicit coordinated_by, embodies_method, uses_method, and pursues_goal relations. Convenience labels derived from them are generated projections, not new canonical axes.
propose.boundary: Identity Relation is not an endpoint, identity equality, authority transfer, inferred context membership, directory dependency, or canonical convenience label.
propose.drift_route: Return through CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE, then definitions-governance owner review.

claim_ceiling: This Lab-local registry contains six context-bound Define handling records for one CML-07 use. It is not the CyberAlchemy canonical Definition registry and grants no source, semantic, owner, construction, implementation, publication, release, or deployment authority.
